role: An EntityDamageSource where the damage comes from a projectile or thrower's target (arrows, fireballs, thrown items): the indirect entity is who gets the kill credit.

members.name: indirectEntity
members.note: Read apart from the shooter only when an arrow has no shooter (causeArrowDamage(this, this): the knockback from the arrow, EntityMob's entityToAttack on it). That needs a dispenser's arrow (world.conf redstone = off) or an arrow saved mid-flight (EntityArrow keeps no shooter in NBT), which takes a chunk unload within the second or two an arrow flies; not staged here, left as a follow-up. Every other indirect source passes its shooter or thrower as getEntity (dmg_is_indirect).

members.name: getSourceOfDamage
members.note: The projectile's kind is the source kind (arrow, thrown, fireball, indirect magic) that the readers test; the skeleton's snipe test rides player_arrow_hit.

members.name: getEntity
members.note: every indirect source passes the shooter or thrower as the attacker; EntityEnderman branches on dmg_is_indirect

notes: Arrows (DMG_ARROW), thrown items (DMG_THROWN), fireballs (DMG_FIREBALL) and harming splashes with a thrower (DMG_INDIRECT_MAGIC) are the indirect kinds; the enderman teleports on each, and the shooter is the revenge target and the attacking player. lane/idxblocks: the shooterless arrow is the dispenser switch or a mid-flight unload.
